title: Emerald Saver Account: Boosting your APY with eco-partner products
summary: Explains how the Emerald Saver Account earns an additional +0.75% APY bonus when an eligible eco-partner relationship is active. Covers qualifying actions (hold an eligible Business EcoCard/Green Rewards Card, link via online banking, maintain good standing), activation/timing (prospective interest accrual), and what happens when eligibility ends plus troubleshooting steps.
